manifestations.description: apart from the thumb, all fingers in his left hand still suffered from different level of numbness
he could not stretch his little finger to its full extent
he could not bend his ring finger in full

treatments_received.treatment: Suture of index, middle and ring finger

source: The little finger flexor tendon was repaired.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Tendon repair / Suture of tendon of hand

treatments_received.treatment: Occupational therapy (9 sessions from 21 June 2010 to 20 August 2010)
source: Then, he received 9 sessions of occupational therapy training from 21 June 2010 to 20 August 2010.

treatments_received.treatment: Tenolysis and full thickness skin graft for left little finger flexion contracture (skin graft taken from groin)
source: On 1 September 2010, he was re-admitted for tenolysis and full thickness skin graft for his left little finger flexion contracture.
The skin graft was taken from his groin.

losses.description: Apart from the thumb, all fingers in his left hand still suffered from different level of numbness; inability to fully extend the little finger and fully flex the ring finger.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Because of the medical condition of his left fingers, he cannot now play darts which he loved to play prior to the accident.
